svg.title: Featured projects
svg.desc: 01 VR GeoNusa — Interactive 3D Geometry Learning: Interactive WebXR platform for learning geometry through Indonesian heritage — 360° tours of Borobudur and Prambanan. 02 SIPERTA — Land & Asset Information System: Land information system for West Bandung Regency — web-mapped spatial data, SHP uploads, Excel imports, cross-agency search. 03 ARSIS — Construction Project Monitoring: Construction monitoring platform that replaced Excel recaps with automated reports, S-Curve tracking, RAB budgets, and daily logs. 04 CryptoWave — Immersive Editorial Redesign: Editorial redesign of a crypto news and research site — Three.js wave hero, GSAP scroll motion, live routes and content.
